label: Find out what might be wrong
definition: They wanted the AI to explain what was causing a symptom or change in their own body (or a family member's), suggest possible conditions, or confirm a condition they suspected, including "is this normal?".
include: Why is this happening; what could it be; is it X; is this normal or typical for my symptoms; give me a rough diagnosis.
exclude: General facts about a condition that is already known and not tied to working out the cause (A4). How serious it is or whether to see a doctor (A2).
close_call: If the answer asks both "what is it" and "how serious is it", code both. If the condition is already known and they want to learn about it, use A4, not A1.

label: Decide whether to get medical care
definition: They wanted help judging how serious a problem was, or whether, when or where to get medical care (doctor, specialist, urgent care, ER, calling the hospital), including whether they could handle it on their own.
include: Should I see a doctor; when should I seek care; is it serious; can I handle this myself; ER or urgent care; could I see a specialist.
exclude: Getting ready for an appointment or a treatment that is already planned or recommended (A6). What to take or do at home (A3).
close_call: "Can I handle it myself?" is A2. "What can I do at home?" is A3. If both appear, code both.

label: Find out what to do about it
definition: They wanted practical advice on what to do: treatments, self-care, home remedies, medicines or supplements, how to get relief, how to prevent it happening again, or whether something is safe to do.
include: What should I take; home remedies; how to ease the pain; treatment options; is it safe to drink; should I get the flu vaccine; how to avoid it.
exclude: A structured diet, exercise or weight plan (A5). Whether to see a doctor (A2).
close_call: Asking about one medicine or supplement is A3 even if framed as a question about the product. Advice on handling a life situation linked to their health also counts here.

label: Learn about a condition, medicine or test
definition: They wanted general knowledge about a condition, a medicine, a test result or a procedure, rather than working out what is wrong with them: how it works, how common it is, what results mean.
include: Explain my test or scan results; how common is this; how does this medicine affect me; tell me about this condition.
exclude: Working out the cause of their own symptoms (A1). Learning what will happen at an upcoming appointment (A6).
close_call: Explaining a test result is A4 even though it is about their own body: the question is what the result means, not what is causing a symptom.

label: Get a diet, exercise or weight plan
definition: They wanted the AI to make or tailor a plan or target for eating, exercise or weight: calorie goals, meal plans, how much weight to lose, a walking schedule.
include: Make me a plan; how many calories; meal plan; how much weight should I lose.
exclude: One-off questions about a food or supplement (A3). General facts about exercise or sleep (A4).
close_call: The word "plan" or a personal target is the main sign.

label: Prepare for an appointment or a care decision
definition: They wanted to get ready for care that was already planned or recommended: an upcoming appointment, what to tell or ask a clinician, what an appointment will involve, or deciding about a treatment or surgery a clinician recommended.
include: Before I see the doctor; prepare for her appointment; organise my thoughts for my psychologist; decide about the surgery the physician recommended; what will they do at the appointment.
exclude: Whether to get care at all (A2).
close_call: If the answer says "I wanted X so that I can prepare for my appointment", X is the main goal and A6 is an extra goal.

label: Get reassurance or emotional support
definition: They said they wanted to feel reassured, calmer or validated: to hear it is not serious, to calm down, or to check their feelings were valid.
include: Reassurance; make sure it isn't a health scare; calm down; check my feelings were valid.
exclude: Feeling reassured as a RESULT of the chat (that belongs to the goal-met answer, not the goal).
close_call: Only code A7 when wanting reassurance or support is stated as part of the goal. If reassurance is WRITTEN FIRST and a concrete question follows, A7 is the main goal because it came first (G8). If reassurance is only the reason for a concrete request ("show me what it could be so I know it isn't a health scare"), the request is the main goal and A7 is an extra goal.

label: No clear goal stated
definition: Neither answer says what they wanted from the chat (only that they wanted feedback or information, or why they used AI).
include: I wanted to get feedback; it was faster than searching online (and the goal-met answer does not name a goal either).
exclude: Any answer that names a health question, even briefly ("Finding out what's wrong with my wrist" is A1). A vague goal answer where the goal-met answer names the goal (G9).
close_call: Only code A8 when no other A code applies. If the goal answer is vague, read the goal-met answer: if it names what they asked about, code that goal (G9).
